description: This file defines the configuration for a Chevrolet Camaro 4 engine, including engine parameters, trigger inputs, injection, ignition modes, pin assignments, and various sensor channels. It contains a setup function that initializes the engine's hardware and software configuration.

methods.name: void setCamaro4(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
